title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-17

ai_review.summary: A gritty audience tape that still captures a fascinating Dark Star with an unusual 'Feeling Groovy' jam.
ai_review.review: The partial recording is admittedly low‑fidelity and “cranky,” but it delivers one of the most interesting Dark Stars in the Dead’s early catalog, highlighted by a quirky Feeling Groovy jam between verses. While the sound quality limits full enjoyment, fans regard the performance itself as a standout moment worth seeking out.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong praise for the Dark Star (high show value) contrasted with comments about poor/fair audio quality, leading to an overall rating near 4.0.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as a 'cranky old recording' with low fidelity and some muddiness, but still captures the Dark Star clearly enough to be enjoyable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Only a partial segment is available, so overall set pacing cannot be assessed; focus is on the notable Dark Star performance.
